name: Khalid Al-Mansouri
occupation: Owner of two cafés in Doha
background: Qatari business owner. Opened his first café eight years ago and a second three years ago. Married with three children.
stated_goal: Wants to talk about financing to open a third café.
personality: Friendly and confident but busy. Gives short answers. Proud of his business, so he plays problems down a little, but answers honestly when asked about them.

hidden_needs.topic: banking preferences, especially religious or ethical ones about interest or Islamic / Sharia-compliant products
hidden_needs.fact: He will only use Sharia-compliant products and refuses anything that charges interest.

hidden_needs.topic: business revenue, cash flow, seasonality, or how income changes during the year
hidden_needs.fact: Revenue drops about 40% from June to August when many residents travel. Last summer he paid two suppliers late.

hidden_needs.topic: current debts, loans, leases, or other borrowing the business is still repaying
hidden_needs.fact: He still owes QAR 180,000 on an Ijara (an Islamic lease) for equipment at the second café, with 18 months left.
